_comment: Cross-corpus typology overlay (Phase 24). Maps each LIVE (derived) corpus doc-id to exactly ONE closed-vocabulary typology, so the corpus explorer can group documents across sources/jurisdictions and show COMBINED coverage. This is a SEPARATE analytical overlay: the 4 source dirs + 42 derived records + the grounding core (derive_signals.py) stay byte-frozen. It is validated at the BUILD BOUNDARY in scripts/build.py (closed vocab + referential integrity + total live-doc coverage, fail-loud) — agent-proposed, gate-disposed, human-reviewed. Each label is a categorization fully traceable to the document's stated subject (its title/scope), NOT a model judgment about content. JURISDICTION is derived from the source registry (FinCEN + OFAC = US, FINTRAC = Canada), NOT stored here. NO similarity/overlap/lift metric is derived from this map — only honest set arithmetic over the existing per-indicator coverage.

vocabulary.terrorist-financing: Financing of terrorist organizations and activity
vocabulary.synthetic-opioids: Fentanyl / synthetic-opioid trafficking and precursor procurement
vocabulary.professional-money-laundering: Third-party / professional money-laundering networks and controllers
vocabulary.romance-and-investment-fraud: Romance-baited and confidence investment fraud (incl. pig butchering)
vocabulary.sanctions-evasion: Evasion of financial sanctions via shell/sham/maritime/CVC channels
vocabulary.export-control-evasion: Evasion of US export controls on dual-use goods (BIS)
vocabulary.transnational-organized-crime: Cartel / TCO bulk-cash and commodity-smuggling proceeds
vocabulary.public-benefits-fraud: Pandemic-relief and federal benefit-program fraud (EIP, ERC, child nutrition)
vocabulary.virtual-currency-scam: Convertible virtual currency giveaway / account-takeover scams
vocabulary.child-sexual-exploitation: Laundering of online child sexual exploitation proceeds
vocabulary.underground-banking: Informal value transfer / underground banking schemes
vocabulary.trade-based-money-laundering: Laundering value through sham/fictitious trade transactions, mis-invoicing, and goods-based value transfer
vocabulary.virtual-currency: Illicit activity involving convertible virtual currency (broad CVC laundering and movement)
vocabulary.unlawful-employment: Laundering tied to unlawful employment of non-work-authorized labour and labour-broker payroll schemes
vocabulary.casino-gaming: Money laundering through casinos and the gaming sector
vocabulary.fintrac-sector-baselines: FINTRAC per-regulated-sector ML/TF baseline indicator lists (multi-typology sector guidance)
